items.question: What did Shatori Walker-Kimbrough average in 2026?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Shatori Walker-Kimbrough played 2 games for the Indiana Fever and 13 for the Atlanta Dream, where she averaged 1.3 points. Her best season was 2024 with Washington, when she averaged a career-high 7.5 points in all 40 games and finished third in Sixth Player of the Year voting.

items.question: Who has Shatori Walker-Kimbrough played for in the WNBA?
items.answer: Washington drafted Shatori Walker-Kimbrough sixth overall in 2017, and she made the All-Rookie Team and won the 2019 championship with the Mystics. She has also played for the Phoenix Mercury, Connecticut Sun, Atlanta Dream and Indiana Fever.

items.question: How tall is Shatori Walker-Kimbrough?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Shatori Walker-Kimbrough at 5 feet 9 inches and 140 pounds.

items.question: Did Shatori Walker-Kimbrough play at Maryland?
items.answer: Yes. Shatori Walker-Kimbrough was a three-time First Team All-Big Ten pick and two-time AP Third Team All-American at Maryland. She ranks fourth in school history in career points and set Maryland and Big Ten records for career three-point percentage.

items.question: Where has Shatori Walker-Kimbrough played overseas?
items.answer: Shatori Walker-Kimbrough has played overseas in Turkey, Slovakia, Hungary, Poland and Israel.
